title: Israel Election Ends in Deadlock; October 7 Inquiry Question Left Open
detail: Final results of the October 27, 2026 Knesset election show Netanyahu's bloc with 53 seats and the bloc backing Gadi Eisenkot with 48, per NBC News and Jerusalem Post; neither reaches 61, with Arab parties around 19 seats. The vote was widely framed as deciding what kind of October 7 inquiry Israel gets (a Likud-backed Knesset-selected panel versus a full state commission). Eisenkot has rejected serving under Netanyahu, so no coalition path to establishing an inquiry is yet clear. Exact party seat counts differed between outlets.

media.caption: Final Israeli election results show deadlock
